items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: my uncle, he used to catch crawfish, bullfrogs, Simon Carney did, and sell them.

ctx.x: Yeah. I remember. We got a stage plant. I gave her one side and I kept one side. And we did. And we walked all the way back home where we stopped at my uncle's house. Well, my uncle, he used to catch crawfish, bullfrogs, Simon Carney did, and sell them. I said, well, my mother, when we stopped by there, she got a little, you know, is a borrow, not a give. But she loved me, since it's the thing to cook for my children. My aunt did it. She loved it. Then we left over there, walked and went on to the house. And I…
